title: #345 Television and Communication
prompt: Television has destroyed communication among friends and family. Do you agree with that?

promptSegments.text: Television has destroyed communication among friends and family.

hardVocabulary.enGloss: A key word in this prompt.
A key word in this prompt.

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.
requirements.vi: Nêu mức độ đồng ý hoặc không đồng ý.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.
requirements.vi: Hỗ trợ quan điểm bằng hai lý do rõ ràng.

requirements.en: Use relevant examples when they strengthen an idea.
requirements.vi: Dùng ví dụ phù hợp khi chúng làm rõ ý.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Spending time in front of the TV reduces face-to-face talking, causing family members to be less connected because they do not talk about their day or share fun moments.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Spending time in front of the TV reduces face-to-face talking, causing family members to be less connected because they do not talk about their day or share fun moments.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: TV makes people prefer screen time over real talks because watching TV is easy and requires less effort, causing them to miss chances to talk and play games with friends.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: TV makes people prefer screen time over real talks because watching TV is easy and requires less effort, causing them to miss chances to talk and play games with friends.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: TV can be a tool that helps people talk and spend time together.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: TV can be a tool that helps people talk and spend time together.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: TV can help people keep in touch with friends and family who live far away.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: TV can help people keep in touch with friends and family who live far away.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Television viewing takes up time that should be spent with loved ones, leading to people looking at their own devices and reducing quality time together.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Television viewing takes up time that should be spent with loved ones, leading to people looking at their own devices and reducing quality time together.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Furthermore, TV viewing can make people less skilled at talking face-to-face because they get used to watching stories from others.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Furthermore, TV viewing can make people less skilled at talking face-to-face because they get used to watching stories from others.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The essay argues that television is still a positive and important tool for communication, directly contradicting the implied negative statement.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The essay argues that television is still a positive and important tool for communication, directly contradicting the implied negative statement.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The structure ensures that both body paragraphs present positive aspects (news/knowledge and social connection) to support the 'disagree' stance.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The structure ensures that both body paragraphs present positive aspects (news/knowledge and social connection) to support the 'disagree' stance.

promptTraps.en: Do not write a general essay about the topic without answering the exact task.
promptTraps.vi: Không viết bài chung chung về chủ đề mà không trả lời đúng yêu cầu của đề.

promptTraps.en: Do not explain the statement without making your own position clear.
promptTraps.vi: Không chỉ giải thích nhận định mà quên nêu rõ quan điểm cá nhân.

faq.questionVi: Đề này đang hỏi điều gì?
faq.answerEn: Break the prompt into its direct requirements before choosing ideas.
faq.answerVi: Hãy tách đề thành các yêu cầu trực tiếp trước khi chọn ý.

faq.questionEn: How many main ideas should I use?
faq.questionVi: Tôi nên dùng bao nhiêu ý chính?
faq.answerEn: Use two developed points with explanation and relevant examples.
faq.answerVi: Dùng hai luận điểm được phát triển bằng giải thích và ví dụ phù hợp.

faq.questionEn: Can I use a personal example?
faq.questionVi: Tôi có thể dùng ví dụ cá nhân không?
faq.answerEn: Yes, if it directly supports the point and remains relevant to the prompt.
faq.answerVi: Có, nếu ví dụ trực tiếp hỗ trợ luận điểm và vẫn liên quan đến đề.

faq.answerEn: Avoid memorised general sentences and any idea that does not answer the task.
faq.answerVi: Tránh câu chung học thuộc và mọi ý không trả lời đúng yêu cầu.
